content.text: The change is purely presentational: it wraps an existing `` in a truthy guard so `` doesn't render (which React errors on in dev). No new sinks are introduced. - `g.imageUrl` still flows into `img src` exactly as before (only now gated on being non-empty). No new attacker-influenceable interpolation, no new URL/path/shell/SQL/eval/filesystem sink. - `Link href={`/closet/${g.id}`}` is unchanged by this diff. - Test file only spies on `console.error` and asserts DOM state — no security surface. - No auth check, no data flow, no parser/validator, no allowlist/registry, no logging of sensitive fields. There is nothing here to trace to a security sink. Returning an empty findings list.
